item.title: Clojure Databases in 2026: XTDB vs Datahike vs Datalevin — Which Datalog Engine Should You Actually Use?
item.description: You have a Postgres instance, a growing pile of JOIN statements, and a nagging feeling that your schema was designed for a world with fewer relationships than the one you now live in. Datalog promises pattern matching over facts instead of ten-table joins — but the Clojure ecosystem offers three serious engines, and they are not interchangeable. XTDB rewrote itself into an immutable SQL database. Datahike kept the Datomic API and put your storage backend on a plug. Datalevin forked LMDB and made embedded Datalog genuinely fast.
